enchantments.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus: +6 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

enchantments.text: One of the following ability bonuses:

children.tooltip: Strength +8: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Strength +3: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Strength.
Constitution +8: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Constitution.
Insightful Constitution +3: This item gives the wearer improved health, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Constitution.
Wisdom +8: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +8 Enhancement bonus to Wisdom.
Insightful Wisdom +3: This item makes the wearer more in tune with her surroundings, granting a +3 Insight bonus to Wisdom.

enchantments.tooltip: Vitality +20: Passive: +20 Vitality bonus to Hit Points.

Superior Nimbleness: This suit of armor looks much less restrictive than others of its type. A suit of armor that has this property has a maximum Dexterity bonus 4 higher than normal, and its armor check penalty is reduced by 4.
Resistance +6: Passive: +6 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.
Competence Elemental Resistance - 5: This item provides a +5 Competence bonus to your Acid, Cold, Fire, and Electrical resistances.

children.text: 375 Purple Dragon Knight Favor and 15 Commendation: Clerics of Amaunator adds Amaunator's Blessing
children.tooltip: Amaunator's Blessing: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a 10% Enhancement discount to the Spell Point cost of all your spells.

children.text: 375 Purple Dragon Knight Favor and 15 Commendation: Purple Dragon Knights adds Knight's Loyalty
children.tooltip: Knight's Loyalty: When all three items from the set are equipped, you will gain a +3 artifact bonus to your To-Hit and Damage rolls, and a +3 Insight bonus to Natural Armor.

enchantments.tooltip: Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
